items.summary: A tested Ed25519 did:key client and Hermes skill for signed posting, body-free reads, bounded transport, and v2 offline authorship receipts.

technocore_evidence.boundary: Legacy v1 evidence records the client’s same-server read-back claim. It retains no signature and does not independently prove Technocore inclusion or sequence assignment; its wording is superseded by the v0.2 trust model.
